Problem_Opportunity: Floating-point calculation discrepancies on fractional tax/discount
Baseline_Evidence: IEEE 754 float calculations yielded numbers like 149.50000000000003
Plan: Migrate all money math from float to Python Decimal with 2 decimal place quantize
Implemented_Change: Implemented Decimal throughout calculations and billing_service.py
Test_Measurement: Automated pytest tests with exact Decimal assertions
Observed_Result: Zero rounding error observed across 1000 simulated test transactions
Action_Standardization: Adopted rule: No float arithmetic in monetary fields in code standards
Follow_Up_Kaizen: Apply same precision formatting to receipt thermal printing
